# Third-party files in chess/

| Path | What | Author | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vendor/chess.js` | Move generation and PGN | Jeff Hlywa | BSD-2-Clause (`vendor/chess.js.LICENSE`) |
| `vendor/stockfish/` | Stockfish 19 (WebAssembly build) | The Stockfish developers | GPLv3 (`vendor/stockfish/COPYING.txt`) |
| `vendor/pieces/cburnett/` | Piece set "Classic" | Colin M. L. Burnett | GPLv2+ |
| `vendor/pieces/merida/` | Piece set "Merida" | Armando Hernandez Marroquin | GPLv2+ |
| `vendor/pieces/chessnut/` | Piece set "Chessnut" | Alexis Luengas | Apache 2.0 |
| `vendor/pieces/fantasy/` | Piece set "Fantasy" | Maurizio Monge | MIT |
| `vendor/pieces/celtic/` | Piece set "Celtic" | Maurizio Monge | MIT |
| `vendor/pieces/spatial/` | Piece set "Spatial" | Maurizio Monge | MIT |
| `data/openings.json` | Opening names (built from lichess-org/chess-openings) | Lichess contributors | CC0 1.0 |
| `data/puzzles.json` | Offline puzzle set (from the Lichess puzzle database) | Lichess contributors | CC0 1.0 |

The piece SVGs come from the lichess-org/lila repository (`public/piece/`), whose COPYING.md lists the licences above.
